content: coffee A controlled blast on a movie set close to the O2 venue in London ignited a fire that ruined a van and harmed a car and a lorry. Fire crews were summoned to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown just before eight o’clock on Saturday. The flames were brought under control a little over an hour later when about twenty‑five firefighters arrived, and nobody was hurt. Officials said the blaze stemmed from a scheduled filming activity near the arena, which will host shows by Niall Horan and Texas next week. The London fire brigade updated on X that the fire in Silvertown is now contained, noting that one vehicle was destroyed while most of a car and a lorry suffered damage, with no injury reports. They added that the fire followed a deliberate explosion on the set that escaped control, that firefighters acted swiftly to put it out, and that teams will stay on site for the rest of the evening. The yard lies near the Thames cable‑car link, and a Metropolitan Police spokesman said they are aware of accounts of blasts heard in the area of the O2 in Greenwich.
